homePage.title: Courtly - Book Sports Courts, Build Teams, Play Together
homePage.description: Discover and book sports courts near you, create or join teams, and organize games with friends. The ultimate platform for sports enthusiasts.

hero.flow: Book, recruit, and play from one flow
hero.copy: Discover high-quality venues, manage your next match, and keep team logistics in one sharp, mobile-first workspace.
hero.summary: Courtly keeps search, booking, team status, and reminders on one board so the game does not stall between messages.

features.title: One platform for venue search, booking, and team operations.
features.copy: The product should feel sharp enough for operators and clear enough for casual players. Each workflow is reduced to the few decisions that actually move a session forward.

items.discoveryDescription: Search by city, sport, and price without losing the fast scan of court quality.
items.bookingDescription: Schedule time slots quickly, confirm availability, and keep payment tied to the booking flow.
items.squadsDescription: Run open roster spots, member approvals, and team chat from the same operator surface.
items.paymentDescription: Keep totals, confirmations, and receipts visible so players know the booking is locked.
items.remindersDescription: Give players the session status they need without burying core actions under notification clutter.
items.trustDescription: Use proof, operator clarity, and consistent UI states to keep bookings credible.

testimonials.title: Built for people who need the session to happen on time.
testimonials.copy: The product earns trust when it removes friction from the last mile: finding a court, confirming who is in, and making the match feel locked.

items.aQuote: We stopped juggling chats, screenshots, and separate payment reminders. Courtly gave the whole session one control room.
items.sQuote: The difference is speed. I can find a court, confirm a slot, and bring doubles together without getting lost in the flow.
items.mQuote: Our squad finally has a clean system for approvals, match planning, and session details. It feels built for actual weekly play.

cta.title: Make the next match easier to book, easier to organize, and harder to drop.
cta.copy: Courtly is built for recurring sports sessions, not one-off booking widgets.

footer.tagline: Premium athletic booking and team ops.
footer.copy: Search high-quality venues, keep your team organized, and run the session with one reliable operating layer.
footer.copyright: Copyright {year} Courtly. Built for recurring play.

login.title: Book faster. Organize better. Stay game ready.
login.copy: One sign-in gets you from discovery to booking, team coordination, and operator tools without switching mental gears.

login.featureRoleCopy: Admins land in review mode, players land in their workspace.
login.featureFlowCopy: Clear state changes from request to verification.
